population.tail_bin: greater than last inclusive upper bound

scope: Structural reinforcement inventory for two already-covered validation fine cells; no query selection or ranking.

target_cells.vote_upper_relation: Actual selected-membership votes equal the upper bound at exactly 500 eligible neighbors; above 500 it is an upper bound, not an observed count.

v17_cost_summary.interpretation: These three observations belong to one old query, so they measure temporal variation and do not establish within-cell identity variation. V17 reused these saved V6 timings; it did not rerun this anchor.

structural_quantile_method: Nearest rank ceil(q*N), separately across all population rows and across eligible rows after the complete 218-identity historic exclusion. The full frozen roster was read through EOF.
anchor_contract: Resolve each existing anchor from the original V5/V6 fixed48 selection by full-roster fine cell. Each target has exactly one. Anchors remain excluded from new selection. Any prospective paired-in-time anchor repeats must have separate counts from new identities and must not change historical or coverage counts.
selection_design_constraints: Freeze a new salt, per-cell quota and structural-only order in the subsequent specification. No selection is performed by this inventory. Independently full-sort the eligible keys and compare the final sealed list before ranking; no replacement seed, quota transfer or timing-based choice.
coverage_interpretation: Both cells already have comparable probes. Reinforcement increases distinct sampled identities but cannot increase cell coverage beyond the existing 55/55. Retain separate old-anchor and newly selected cohorts when comparing costs.
privacy: Only aggregate cells, counts, structural quantiles, cost summaries and source fingerprints are public; no per-query keys or identities.
